criteria.text: Board, metadata and lifecycle transport rechecks withdraw presentation and writes, then restore the original draft and keyboard focus only after same-actor authorized discovery; no automatic mutation occurs.
Definitive access refusal, account change and pending/completed deletion retire the draft; restored membership does not resurrect it.
Explicit unchanged retry after an uncertain save retains the original request body and idempotency key; exactly one canonical private Board is present after reload and return.

The affected workflow is usable at 320/390/768/1280px, 200% tablet text and keyboard, with no page overflow and passing applicable accessibility checks; original broad workflow assertions and deadlines remain unchanged.

Controlled tests prove the original failure and repaired reset/disconnect, denial, lifecycle and retry behavior; actual Demo API browser workflows prove canonical persistence and return with visual evidence.

After same-actor access recovery replaces the Board launcher, both Cancel and Escape restore focus to the current permitted launcher. Reopening starts an empty unsent draft; no Board is created by cancel/reopen. Existing access withdrawal and original-command retry behavior remain intact.

Controlled Cancel/Escape cases fail before the repair and pass after it; the four-width running workflow verifies current focus and empty reopening before explicit canonical Board creation, with unchanged assertions, zero automatic replay and retained original-key recovery.

An admitted user opens Organization home, enters a Board draft, survives Board/metadata/lifecycle transport rechecks with protected presentation withdrawn, and recovers the original fields and current keyboard focus only after same-actor authorized discovery.
Confirmed account/access refusal or pending/completed deletion retires the draft; subsequent access does not resurrect it. No mutation is sent while admission is uncertain.
Explicit unchanged retry after a lost committed reply uses the original key and request body, creates exactly one private Board, and reaches canonical read/reload and Organization directory return.

At 320/390/768/1280px and 200% tablet text, native keyboard, responsive navigation, applicable accessibility checks and visible focus work. Cancel/Escape after recovery focus the current visible launcher; reopening starts empty before a fresh explicit submission.

Reconcile the retained implementation and tests, validate this slice’s four business/UX criteria with exact current evidence, retain all failed/skipped checks, and prepare a reviewable integration without closing the broader creation/edit or parent PRD scope.
Executed current controlled and native tests validate all four slice criteria; broad regression and target integration remain separate required gates, with no skipped case promoted to a pass.

A recovered Board creation remains bound to the account that opened the command. Replacing the browser account cannot execute its unchanged retry as another actor, even when that actor is independently an Organization member; the server refuses before mutation and the original canonical Board remains unchanged.

A stale foreground command opened by A cannot create or replay under B after browser account replacement, including when B can normally create Boards in the same Organization; refusal does not mutate the protected graph.

Use existing optional expectedActorId API conventions, preserve legacy POST clients and successful original key/body receipts, and allow a fresh properly bound authorized actor command without adding permissions or changing schemas/events.

Current genuine native account-replacement and four-width recovery workflows pass with unchanged original deadlines/assertions and explicit withdrawal after refusal; final full regression and release/integration gates remain required.
Real endpoint tests verify changed/malformed expected actor refusal, unchanged state, valid current actor creation, successful same-key replay and unchanged legacy-client behavior.

Two current accounts with real membership, genuine transport delay and a committed lost reply prove that unchanged retry cannot become a replacement-actor Board; current actor, keys/body, canonical counts, original Board and protected UI withdrawal are checked.

An established ordinary Board-directory authority reset retires an unsubmitted Board-creation review and its consent/draft. A newly permitted launcher starts a fresh empty review. Bootstrap or transport uncertainty and submitted original-command recovery retain their bounded same-account behavior, without automatic replay or discarding an uncertain receipt.

Retire only unsubmitted Board creation reviews after established validated directory reset, preserve initial/transport draft and submitted original-key recovery, canonical authorization and visible permitted return. Reuse current UI/protocol without changing wire/API/event schemas.
Run this bounded current validation with original assertions, exact source/results and failed/pass evidence; preserve sibling recovery, role/tenant/Portal, responsive/focus and release gates.
Run this bounded current validation with original assertions, exact source/results and failed/pass evidence; preserve sibling recovery, role/tenant/Portal, responsive/focus and release gates.
